text: Do you need a solicitor when buying a house in Queensland? Here's a quick guide from Davoren Associates. Only qualified legal practitioners can give legal advice on a contract of sale. Real estate agents can't advise you on contract terms. A solicitor conducts title searches, reviews council and zoning records, and checks for caveats and easements. They also manage key deadlines, like the five business day cooling-off period, finance approval, building and pest, and settlement. If you're buying a home on the Gold Coast, our team can help. Speak with Davoren Associates.
